tasks.instruction: A blue tiger sits cross-legged on a floor cushion, one arm extended forward with the palm open and fingers gently spread, as if offering a small object to the viewer.
tasks.camera: Eye-level medium shot, slight front angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: The extended hand is fully visible with palm facing camera and all five fingers unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐伸手展示掌心，递物姿态

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans against a kitchen counter, holding up one open palm near shoulder height while inspecting it, fingers casually splayed and relaxed.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera clearly; all five fingers separated and visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠柜台抬手看掌心，手指自然张开

tasks.instruction: Reaching up to a high shelf, the blue tiger stretches one arm overhead, palm turned outward toward the viewer, fingers reaching long and clearly separated.
tasks.camera: Low angle looking up, vertical composition
tasks.visibility_requirement: Overhead palm is fully presented toward camera, no fingers cutting off frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 抬手够高处，掌心朝外展示手指

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger shields its eyes from the sun with one flat open palm held above its brow, fingers pressed together but the full hand and pads visible from below.
tasks.camera: Low three-quarter angle, close-up on upper body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm underside and all five fingers visible despite shading the face.
tasks.intent_zh: 举手遮阳，掌心朝下露出肉垫

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a park bench, the blue tiger rests one forearm on its knee with the palm turned up and fingers loosely curled, catching a few falling leaves.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Upturned palm fully visible with each of the five fingers discernible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐长椅接落叶，掌心向上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stretches one arm across a table toward a chess piece, palm open and fingers spread wide as it reaches, clearly displaying the yellow palm pads.
tasks.camera: Overhead tabletop angle, close on arm
tasks.visibility_requirement: Extended palm faces camera; all five long fingers separated and in frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 伸手越过桌面取棋子，掌心朝上

tasks.instruction: Standing at a bus stop, the blue tiger checks a wristwatch by turning one hand palm-up, fingers gently fanned to read the time.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand with watch is fully visible, all fingers unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 公交站抬手看表，掌心向上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a low drawer, one hand pressed flat on top of it with palm down, fingers splayed to push it closed.
tasks.camera: High angle looking down at the hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-down hand clearly shows back of hand and all five fingers spread on the surface.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪姿手压抽屉，五指张开

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a sink, the blue tiger cups one hand under the faucet, palm up and fingers together, catching water with the yellow pads visible.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Cupped palm faces camera enough to see all five fingers and pads.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身水槽接水，掌心向上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor and holds one palm out toward a curious puppy, fingers relaxed and slightly spread in a gentle stop gesture.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Forward-facing palm and all five fingers clearly visible above the puppy.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地伸手安抚小狗，掌心朝前

tasks.instruction: In a library, the blue tiger turns a single page with one hand, palm angled toward the viewer and fingers delicately separated over the paper.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Page-turning hand visible with palm partly facing camera and all five fingers discernible.
tasks.intent_zh: 图书馆翻书页，掌心微朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at a chalkboard and presses one open palm flat against it, fingers spread as if making a handprint.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm pressed to board faces camera, all five fingers spread and fully visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 黑板前手掌按板，五指张开

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a porch step, the blue tiger raises one hand palm-out to catch a tossed ball, fingers spread wide and reaching upward.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Open hand reaching up shows full palm and all five spread fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐台阶举手接球，掌心朝上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches to examine a flower, one palm hovering open above the petals, fingers gently fanned to avoid crushing it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Hovering palm faces camera with all five fingers visible above the flower.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲下悬手护花，掌心朝下张开

tasks.instruction: At a door, the blue tiger presses one palm flat against it while leaning in to listen, fingers spread across the wood.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Hand on door is angled so the full palm and five fingers remain visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 手掌贴门倾听，五指张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits at a desk and raises one open palm beside its face, fingers splayed in a playful peekaboo gesture toward the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera clearly with all five fingers spread and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐桌前抬手做躲猫猫，掌心朝前

tasks.instruction: Balancing a book on one upturned palm, the blue tiger keeps its fingers spread and steady while looking at the cover.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Supporting palm is fully visible beneath the book with all five fingers clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 掌心托书保持平衡，五指张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels to tie a shoelace, one hand turned palm-up holding the lace loop with long fingers clearly separated.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand holding the loop shows all five fingers and pads clearly.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪姿系鞋带，掌心向上捏环

tasks.instruction: Reaching into a backpack on a chair, the blue tiger extends one arm with palm open toward the viewer as it pulls out a notebook.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Emerging hand faces camera with full palm and five fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 从背包抽本子，掌心朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side propped on one elbow, holding the other hand up palm-out with fingers relaxed and slightly curled.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera with all five fingers visible despite relaxed curl.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺撑肘，抬手展示掌心

tasks.instruction: Standing in a garden, the blue tiger sprinkles seeds from one open palm, fingers spread flat and angled toward the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Open palm is tilted toward camera showing all five fingers and yellow pads.
tasks.intent_zh: 花园撒种子，掌心倾斜朝前

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a stool and holds one hand flat above a candle to feel warmth, palm down and fingers fully spread.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-down hand above candle shows all five spread fingers and back of hand clearly.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐凳手悬蜡烛上方取暖，五指张开

tasks.instruction: At a market stall, the blue tiger holds out one open palm to receive change, fingers gently spread toward the vendor.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Receiving palm faces camera with all five fingers visible as coins drop.
tasks.intent_zh: 市集伸手接零钱，掌心朝上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out a window and waves one open palm at a passing friend, fingers splayed wide and palm facing forward.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Waving palm faces camera with all five fingers spread and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 探窗挥手打招呼，掌心朝前

tasks.instruction: Crouched by a campfire, the blue tiger warms one open palm near the flames, fingers spread and angled toward the viewer.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm angled toward camera shows all five fingers and pads clearly against the firelight.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁烤手，掌心朝前

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a train seat and holds one palm up to inspect a small ticket, fingers delicately spread.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand with ticket shows all five fingers and pads facing camera.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐火车看车票，掌心向上

tasks.instruction: Reaching across a counter to press a button, the blue tiger extends one arm with palm forward and fingers spread wide.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Forward palm with spread fingers fully visible pressing the button.
tasks.intent_zh: 伸手按按钮，掌心朝前张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a mat and holds one hand palm-up in its lap, fingers loosely fanned for a short meditation.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm-up hand in lap is fully visible with all five fingers clear from above.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐冥想，掌心向上放膝上

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a map spread on a table, the blue tiger pins a location with one flat open palm, fingers spread across the paper.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm on map faces camera with all five spread fingers visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身地图手掌按位置，五指张开

tasks.instruction: Standing in a doorway, the blue tiger raises one open palm in a calm stop gesture toward a friend, fingers straight and clearly separated.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised palm faces camera with all five fingers straight and fully visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 门口抬手示意停下，掌心朝前
